records.query: 需获取眼睑/结膜病变部位的活检病理报告及特殊染色结果，明确是否存在非干酪样肉芽肿等克罗恩病相关组织学改变，并排除感染性病因；同时补充皮肤科会诊记录及抗TNF治疗期间皮疹变化，以鉴别药物相关反应。此为验证克罗恩相关眼睑炎症的核心依据。

Eyelid Manifestations Before and After Treatment
A, Blepharitis and ectropion during TNF-α inhibitor treatment. B, Resolution after treatment discontinuation.

records.query: Need the eyelid biopsy pathology report with special stains (e.g., PAS, Gram, acid-fast) to identify non-caseating granulomas confirming Crohn-associated eyelid inflammation and exclude infectious etiologies; also need clinical documentation of lesion response to adalimumab adjustment or discontinuation to differentiate anti-TNF-induced dermatologic reaction. These are core for verifying the leading hypothesis.

Need the eyelid lesion biopsy pathology report and dermatology consultation notes to confirm granulomatous inflammation consistent with Crohn-associated eyelid disease and rule out anti-TNF-induced psoriasiform or eczematous reaction.

Need the eyelid biopsy pathology results with special stains to confirm non-caseating granulomas, the dermatology consultation's detailed morphologic description to distinguish anti-TNF-induced psoriasiform or eczematous reaction, and conjunctival swab bacterial/fungal cultures to exclude infectious blepharitis; these will directly verify or eliminate the leading hypothesis.

Need the eyelid biopsy pathology report with special stains (PAS, Gram, acid-fast) and dermatology consultation documentation of lesion timeline relative to anti-TNF dosing; these are essential to confirm anti-TNF-induced dermatologic reaction and exclude infectious or Crohn-associated eyelid inflammation.

Need the detailed anti-TNF medication timeline (agent, dose, duration, interval changes) and concurrent immunosuppressant use, along with the dermatology consultation's morphologic description of eyelid lesions and documentation of any recurrence upon rechallenge; these are critical to confirm the drug-induced temporal relationship and exclude Crohn-associated eyelid inflammation.

bindings.label: Bilateral scaly, thickened, erythematous eyelids with ectropic lower eyelids, crusty eyelid margin plaques, and diffuse conjunctival hyperemia
Patient is a 15-year-old boy with biopsy-proven Crohn disease, initially on infliximab then switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse
Physical examination showed bilateral scaly, thickened, erythematous upper and lower eyelids; both lower eyelids were ectropic; crusty plaques on eyelid margins; diffuse conjunctival hyperemia
Visual acuity was 20/20 OU and the rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable
Eyelid lesions appeared during TNF-α inhibitor treatment and resolved after discontinuation
No eyelid biopsy or special staining pathology data were obtained
